guesses.reason: Small, sturdy body with a long, wavy coat, a beard and mustache, a gold-and-cream coat with darker shading on the ears, and a short broad muzzle all point to Shih Tzu.
The crimped, curly texture of the wet coat suggests poodle ancestry, as in a Shih-Poo.
The shaggy parted coat, drop ears feathered with darker tips, and compact low-set frame resemble a Lhasa Apso.

breed.appearance: Fluffy is a small, compact dog with a shaggy, curly-wavy coat (damp in this photo) in a tan-and-gold color with cream highlights on the face and dark brown-black tipping on the long, hanging drop ears. Round dark-brown eyes peek out from under a scruffy fringe, set above a short muzzle with a black nose and a messy cream beard and mustache. The legs are short and sturdy, covered in long, tousled furnishings, giving an endearing ragamuffin look.
breed.fun_fact: Shih Tzus were bred as royal lap companions in ancient China, so cuddling is literally in their job description!
